# Beta Plan

Beta is the second note. Its title should be searchable even when the file
name alone is not typed.

1. Search `beta plan` and expect the title match.
2. Search `notes beta` and expect the path match.
3. Search `alpha beta` and expect no result (tokens are ANDed).
